applied.rules: Raptor closures run March through late summer and name The Wall, Far Side and Cat Wall; areas cleared by the surveys in late April or early May reopen, so check the closure notices before climbing. Wait 24-48 hours after rain before climbing on the sandstone. Pack out human waste. Cross private land on existing trails and leave gates as you found them. Protect cryptobiotic soil and archaeological sites.
